description: Boundary coverage for revision-string validation: empty/partial semver, leading zeros, stray characters, non-git revision prefixes, and git hashes that are non-hex, too short, or too long. Each malformed input must yield a usage-error exit code (2) and a language-neutral category plus domain reason.

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=2
input=
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected end of input while parsing major version number

exit_code=2
input=1.2
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected end of input while parsing minor version number

exit_code=2
input=1.2.3.4
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected character '.' after patch version number

exit_code=2
input=01.0.0
error=invalid_version
reason=invalid leading zero in major version number

exit_code=2
input=1.0.x
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected character 'x' while parsing patch version number

exit_code=2
input=v1.0.0
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected character 'v' while parsing major version number

exit_code=2
input=abc.def.ghi
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected character 'a' while parsing major version number

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1 
error=invalid_version
reason=unexpected character ' ' after patch version number

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@svn:1234
error=unknown_revision
reason=unrecognized revision type, expected 'git:' prefix

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@hg:abcdef
error=unknown_revision
reason=unrecognized revision type, expected 'git:' prefix

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@git:
error=invalid_git_hash
reason=unrecognized git hash, expected 40 hex digits

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@git:00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff001122zz
error=invalid_git_hash
reason=unrecognized git hash, expected 40 hex digits

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@git:zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
error=invalid_git_hash
reason=unrecognized git hash, expected 40 hex digits

exit_code=2
input=1.0.1@git:00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566
error=invalid_git_hash
reason=unrecognized git hash, expected 40 hex digits
